patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price broke above the prior swing high around 65500 following the swing low near 62200. Price subsequently made a higher high near 66000.

patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Left shoulder formed near 65500/64000, head formed at the swing low near 62200, right shoulder formed near 64200/66000. Price broke above the neckline around 65500 and is currently retesting it near 65445.

patterns_found.name: Bullish Flag
patterns_found.evidence: Strong impulsive rally from approximately 64000 to 66000 followed by a slight downward/sideways consolidation near current price 65445.
